title: Statcounter: four months after its release, iOS 26 is in use by only about 15% of iPhone users; in January 2025, about 63% of users were on iOS 18 (Ed Hardy/Cult of Mac)
summary: Ed Hardy / Cult of Mac: Statcounter: four months after its release, iOS 26 is in use by only about 15% of iPhone users; in January 2025, about 63% of users were on iOS 18 — Only a tiny percentage of iPhone users have installed iOS 26, according to data from a web analytics service.
